markup:
A **solar generator can last anywhere from 2 hours to several days on a single charge**, depending on its battery capacity and what you're powering.

## Typical runtime by battery size

| Battery capacity | 100W device | 500W device |
|---|---|---|
| 300Wh (small) | 2.5 hours | 0.5 hours |
| 500Wh (medium) | 4.3 hours | 0.85 hours |
| 1,000Wh (large) | 8.5 hours | 1.7 hours |
| 2,000Wh (extra large) | 17 hours | 3.4 hours |
| 3,000Wh (very large) | 25.5 hours | 5.1 hours |

<caption>Estimates assume 85% usable energy, accounting for conversion losses. Actual results vary.</caption>

## How long can it power common appliances?

For a 1,000Wh solar generator:

| Appliance | Estimated runtime |
|---|---|
| Phone (15Wh per charge) | 50+ charges |
| Laptop (60W) | 14 hours |
| Wi-Fi router (10W) | 85 hours |
| LED light (10W) | 85 hours |
| TV (100W) | 8.5 hours |
| Mini fridge (average 40W) | 21 hours |
| Space heater (1,500W) | 34 minutes* |

*Only if the generator supports 1,500W continuous output.*

## What if you recharge it with solar panels?

With sufficient sunlight, a solar generator can keep running much longer.

For example, a 1,000Wh generator paired with a 200W solar panel might recover roughly 600–800Wh during a sunny day, depending on conditions.

## Calculate your runtime

{@body const [capacity,setCapacity] = DIL.useState("1000")}
{@body const [watts,setWatts] = DIL.useState("100")}
{@body const runtime = Number(capacity)*0.85/Number(watts)}
<box border radius="xl" padding={3} gap={3}>
  <row align="center" gap={2}>
    <box flex="1" gap={1}>
      <label>Battery capacity (Wh)</label>
      <input inputType="number" value={capacity} onChange={setCapacity}/>
    </box>
    <box flex="1" gap={1}>
      <label>Power consumption (W)</label>
      <input inputType="number" value={watts} onChange={setWatts}/>
    </box>
  </row>
  <box background="surface-secondary" radius="lg" padding={3} align="center" gap={1}>
    <text color="secondary" weight="medium" size="xs">Estimated runtime</text>
    <title size="2xl" color="default" tabularNums>{Number(watts)>0 && Number(capacity)>0 ? `${runtime.toFixed(1)} hours` : "—"}</title>
  </box>
</box>

**One question:** Are you asking how long a solar generator can **power appliances on one charge**, or how long its **battery holds a charge when sitting unused** (days, months, or years)? Those are very different.
